pages.text: Create's $(thing)blaze burners$() are an essential component of most late-game features. However, there is no nether in $(#6A2)TerraFirmaCraft$(). One could imagine a way to manufacture a synthetic blaze in order to power the burners, but unfortunately all attempts at creating artificial life have failed so far.

pages.name: The mighty Firebox
pages.text: This is where the $(thing)firebox$() comes into play. It has been modified to be able to provide $(#A64)heat$() to blocks above.

pages.name: It can heat basins...
pages.text: By $(bold)default$(), the $(thing)firebox$() acts as a $(#A64)heated$() blaze burner when it hits $(c)bright red$() (750ºC), and as a $(#46A)superheated$() blaze burner at $(d)brilliant white$() (>1500ºC).$(br)
Fireboxes can also be used to power $(l:steam_engine_changes)steam engines$(), although that logic is a little more complex.
pages.name: ...and steam engines
